_doc: Named NPC questlines (round 38). `npcs` are the people (hub lines per stage); `quests` are the encounters that move a person from stage `need` to stage `set` on the listed levels (0 = Shallows 1-1). Nothing is announced or listed: a person speaks when you come near. kinds: vault (sealed in a rock pocket, bomb it open), rescue (a cage on the floor; touch it, bring the freed creature to the exit), fetch (an item on the floor; bring it to the exit), meet (a person standing on the floor; swim up to him). lines: meet, ask (said as you approach), help (when you act), thank (right after). Hub lines may use {n} (relics delivered) and {left}.

1: My old tank got swept off somewhere in the caves. Green, with a dent.
If you spot it on 1-2 or 1-3, bring it out for me.
2: Air in the tank and a shortcut in the floor. We are square.
The new ring by the dive well drops you at 1-2.

thanks.1: Made it! Thanks for the rescue.
thanks.2: My tank! You found it! Take the shortcut ring: it is yours.

1: Squeak squeak. (Mother is in a cage in the caves too.)
Golden relics, my friend. Heavy, shiny, slightly cursed.
Carry one out through the exit ring, and it is mine.
2: My lantern burns for you now.
Every dive starts a little brighter.

thanks.1: Delighted to be here. Mind the ledge.
thanks.2: Three relics! You have outdone yourself. Take my lantern on every dive.

lines.meet: Hey! Over here! In the rock!
lines.ask: My tank is nearly dry. Blow this wall open, would you?
lines.thank: Find me at the hub. I owe you one.

quests.done: The diver waves, free at last

lines.help: A green tank with a dent: Marlo's! Carry it to the exit.

lines.ask: The latch is stuck. Could you open the cage?

quests.done: It squeaks happily and swims home

lines.ask: I am Pip's mother. Please let me out?

lines.meet: Ah, a visitor! Mind the dust.
lines.ask: I collect golden relics. Bring me three, and I shall make it worth your while.
lines.help: Splendid! I shall set up at your hub.

quests.done: The Collector will wait in the hub
